name: Kayabuki Hazuki
source: The heroine of "[url=/v31432]Makimura Hazuki no Koigatari[/url]," appearing as a guest character. A little while ago, she got married, and has changed her last name. She is still a film geek, and in addition to her work creating independent films, she works part-time at a video rental store.
